questions.solution_text:
$\frac{1}{4}=\frac{4}{16}$ and $\frac{1}{2}=\frac{8}{16}$.
$\frac{9}{16}>\frac{8}{16}$, so $\frac{9}{16}$ could not be placed between the marked fractions.
Both $\frac{5}{16}$ and $\frac{7}{16}$ lie between $\frac{4}{16}$ and $\frac{8}{16}$.
